items.reason: Describes stored XSS from feed HTML saved with raw_html cooking, bypassing sanitization. It also includes the unescaped footer URL problem, but the primary shared issue is unsanitized imported content.
Describes protocol-relative CDN URLs being incorrectly rewritten as paths on the article host.
Describes the same concurrent check-then-create race and unhandled RecordNotUnique exception for duplicate embed URLs.
Describes missing RSS content causing i.content.scrub to raise and abort the feed poll.

Describes anonymous clients varying embed URLs to evade the per-URL retrieval throttle and trigger unbounded retrieval work. The queue-flooding consequence and proposed controller throttle broaden the same abuse.
Describes the substring origin check accepting a foreign origin and allowing forged iframe-resize messages.
Describes the Disqus import regression from switching to import_remote: dead links abort the import and original thread timestamps are lost.
